tickets.title: Prepare estate planning note for attorney
tickets.text: Prepare a planning note for the estate attorney covering Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss's adoption of Elia (finalized 2026-01-09), the preferred guardian discussion, successor trustee considerations (current first successor trustee is Casey Lanternmoss), and account ownership information needed before the attorney revises the 2020 will and revocable trust.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that note by 2026-02-10.

tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Refresh the household profile for Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss using client-provided updates and recent planning notes. Confirm household members, contact preferences, employment status, dependents, trusted contacts, insurance context, estate document status, and any major life changes that may affect planning recommendations. Add Elia Lanternmoss as a dependent, include Jules's updated Cloudberry Kite School Services benefits information, and reflect the household's revised monthly spending of approximately $10,800 after infant care costs were added.

subTasks.title: Collect profile change information
subTasks.text: Request or compile updates for household members, addresses, contact preferences, employment, dependents, and major recent or expected life events. Include Elia Lanternmoss as a dependent, Jules's updated Cloudberry Kite School Services benefits, and the revised monthly spending of approximately $10,800 after infant care costs.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Revise income, savings, spending, retirement timing, education funding, and family support assumptions in the planning record as applicable. Reflect the household's preference to keep at least six months of core expenses in cash while Elia is under age five.

subTasks.title: Identify advice impacts
subTasks.text: Flag changes that may affect tax planning, risk management, estate coordination, cash flow, or investment allocation recommendations. Note the household's immediate planning priorities of guardianship, insurance adequacy, and education funding for Elia.

subTasks.title: Confirm profile completion
subTasks.text: Review the updated profile for consistency and note any remaining open questions for the next client conversation.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to refresh the household profile by 2026-02-03.

tickets.title: Obtain Elia's adoption and identification records
tickets.text: Obtain Elia Lanternmoss's final adoption decree (finalized 2026-01-09), birth certificate, and Social Security number confirmation to support account beneficiary updates and education account paperwork for Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss.

tickets.text: Model survivor income, mortgage payoff, childcare, and education funding assumptions for both Rowan Lanternmoss (Paper Otter Systems, $750,000 group life plus $500,000 Silver Marmot term) and Jules Lanternmoss (Cloudberry Kite School Services, $300,000 group life, no individual term) given the addition of Elia to the household.

Record received documents and route planning questions to the advisor. Obtain the current premium, conversion language, beneficiary page, and any renewal action requirements from the recently arrived Silver Marmot term policy renewal packet before Rowan responds.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to obtain the current premium, conversion language, beneficiary page, and any renewal action requirements before Rowan responds, due 2026-02-06.

tickets.text: Reconcile the beneficiary export for Rowan Lanternmoss's $500,000 individual term life policy with Silver Marmot Insurance, which currently names Casey Lanternmoss as primary beneficiary; update to name Jules Lanternmoss as primary and include Elia Lanternmoss under the updated estate plan structure.

tickets.title: Prepare education funding account comparison for Elia
tickets.text: Compare ownership, contribution, and investment options for opening an education funding account for Elia Lanternmoss, including whether grandparents can contribute directly without changing the household's cash reserve target of at least six months of core expenses while Elia is under age five.
